 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelt word is 'Inedvertent'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Inadvertent'.**
 
• The word '**Inadvertent**' is an **adjective** which means 'not resulting from or achieved through deliberate planning'. **(अनजाने में)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The error was inadvertent and unintentional.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Inedvertent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Tenacious -** tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging or adhering closely **(दृढ़)**
 
• **Temerarious - **recklessly bold **(असावधान)**
 
• **Penitent -** feeling or showing sorrow and regret for having done wrong **(पश्चातापी)**
